# Image

Create images from a description: photos, pictures, illustrations, art, characters and scenes in any aspect ratio. Generated in seconds and saved to your MegaScenes library.

## What it does
Describe the picture and the look you want. Claude picks a model (Nano Banana 2 by default; GPT Image, Seedream, Flux, Ideogram and others on request), tells you the price, and creates the image in your account. Ask for variations or another aspect ratio in the same chat.

**How the files are made:** each image is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Creates new images from text. To edit your own photo, upload it on the MegaScenes site.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install image@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Image talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/image/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each image uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The images show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_image_models` | Models for images with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_image_cost` | Exact price of one image before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_image` | Starts one image in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_image` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A cozy reading nook with rain on the window, watercolor"
- "Four variations of a cyberpunk fox mascot, square"
- "A 16:9 banner of a mountain lake at sunrise"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the image (the description, the style and the aspect ratio) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
